Постройте башню разведчиков — и вы увиди: Build a scout tower — and you'll see which places lie a few steps further ahead.
Постройте лабораторию — и я обеспечу вас: Build a laboratory — and I'll keep you in potions for any expedition.
Поход закончится: всё найденное и спасён: The expedition will end: everything you found and everyone you saved will reach the town.
Проход завален. Среди камней блестят жил: The passage is blocked. Veins of iron glint among the stones, but the ceiling above the rubble is cracking.
Прошлый поход прерван: снаряжение похода: The last expedition was cut short: its gear is lost.
Путники болтают, а я слушаю. Кто где вид: Travellers talk and I listen. Who saw a cage where, where gold glinted, where it's better not to go — it all passes over my counter.
Work the way Ulf taught you.
Smash the skulls and take the jewellery.
Развалины Аурелии, лавовые кузни и зерка: The ruins of Aurelia, the lava forges and the jester's mirror halls.
Разведчик оживает и в благодарность отме: The scout revives and in gratitude marks every sign on your map: now you read the road as he does.
Раны лечатся, проклятия снимаются. Тольк: Wounds heal, curses lift. Just don't come with a curse on your heart.
Рубины выпадают — и вместе с ними что-то: The rubies fall out — and something dark comes out of the sockets with them. A curse falls upon you.
From the top you can see what waits on the road.
Сверху падает глыба. Камень вы всё-таки: A boulder falls from above. You got the stone after all, but at a price.
Свет Затмения меняет травы: они растут б: The Eclipse's light changes herbs: they grow faster and heal better. Dangerous? Certainly. Useful? Extremely.
Свет здесь течёт вниз, как вода. Голос в: Light flows down here like water. A voice inside your head: "Take my power. I don't mind. I'm so lonely."
The scroll is in your bag.
Свод трещит и осыпается. Кристалл вы спа: The vault cracks and crumbles. You saved the crystal, but not your shoulders.
Сгорбленная тень с лопатой копает яму, к: A hunched shadow with a spade digs a pit that has no end. "One more... one more..." it mutters, not noticing you.
Сейф на 4 предмета: они переживут гибель: A safe for 4 items: they survive the hero's death.
Сила бьёт в виски — и вместе с ней что-т: Power pounds at your temples — and with it something cold.
Power pounds at your temples — pure, unmixed. The sun really was generous.
Strong enemies and a better reward.
Склад, библиотеку и башню можно ставить: The warehouse, the library and the tower can go up right now. The forge, the temple, the tavern and the potion shop — only when their masters return. Look for prisoners on the expedition map.
The next mug is on the house.
Слишком далеко: разведчики не видят, что: Too far: the scouts can't see what's there.
Servants of the Eclipse drive a cart with a cage. Inside are people from the town. The guards are few, but alert.
Слухи: знаки на всей карте следующего по: Rumours: the signs on the whole map of the next expedition.
Снаряжение и добыча похода потеряны. Гор: The expedition's gear and loot are lost. The town, its people and the warehouse remain.
Gather them the way Mira taught you.
Спасён: %s — придёт в город, если вы вер: Rescued: %s — they'll come to the town if you return alive.
Старые захоронения под городом: кости, г: Old burial grounds under the town: bones, mushrooms and the first servants of the Eclipse.
